newsitem.title: USA: Amphenol to settle two class actions.
newsitem.headline: Amphenol to settle two class actions.

text.p: Amphenol Corp said Friday it signed a memorandum of understanding to settle two shareholder class actions brought in the Chancery Court of Delaware.

Amphenol said the actions allege violations of fiduciary responsibilities arising out of the execution of an agreement for the merger of Amphenol with NXS Acquisition Corp, a subsidiary of an affiliate of Kohlberg Kravis Roberts and Co, LP. A special meeting of Amphenol shareholders to consider adoption and approval of the merger agreement is scheduled for May 4, Amphenol said.

Under terms of the memorandum of understanding, NXS will waive its right to collect $5 million of a breakup fee of $37.5 million to which it would be entitled under certain circumstances described in the merger agreement, Amphenol said.
